_about: Machine-readable stage list derived from pipeline_design.md. Edit this when the design changes, then run: python experiments/experiment_5/tools/scaffold_stages.py. Nodes = stage x task. 'purpose' may be a string or {task: string}. '{task}' in depends_on is replaced by the node's task.
design_version: pipeline_design.md v1.2 (frozen 2026-10-17; CR-003 audit, CR-004 feature solution)

stages.title: Problem statement
stages.purpose: Fix both checkout tasks, prediction time, stakeholders and their actions, targets and label rules, metrics, the illustrative FN:FP = 5:1 cost, model families, decision rule, grids, budget, seed 42 and the test cutoff (protocol layer a: pre-registered) - before any data is seen.
outputs: task_contract.md (prediction time, stakeholder action, limits, metric and model rationale with verified citations)
gate: Every number later stages need is in protocol.yaml
Decision rule and tie-breaks written before any result
Stakeholder action stated, not only named
Every citation verified to exist and support its claim
protocol.yaml separates pre-registered values from data-dependent values owned by s04 and s05
stages.gate_question: Are tasks, targets, metrics, cost, decision rule and budget fixed before any result?

stages.title: Data preprocessing
stages.purpose: Load and clean the nine Olist tables deterministically, join aggregation-first to one row per order, build both targets with label-availability timestamps, audit every column against checkout time and apply the zero-item classification rule. Population and data-quality rules applied to development and test alike: zero-item orders out of both tasks; classification limited to orders not cancelled or unavailable with a valid review; lead_days > max(100, mean + 12 SD of pre-cutoff orders) and distance_km_max > 4,397.53 km removed as suspected data-entry errors; orders with missing payment_installments_max removed.
outputs: records.csv.gz (IDs for audit + features + targets + timestamps)
data_dictionary.csv (every raw and derived column; NIBRS model, G-58)
figures/data_structure.png (tables, keys, one-to-many links, aggregate-first join)
gate: Only row-local deterministic rules; nothing learned
Every column classified as known or not known at checkout
Minimum vs first review label sensitivity recorded
Input hashes recorded
Data dictionary covers every raw and derived column and matches the leakage tags (G-58)
Per-task test cutoff computed by the 80/20 rule and recorded (not assumed from Milestone 2)
Outlier threshold computed on pre-cutoff orders only; every removal counted in exclusions.csv
order_status, order_approved_at, shipping_limit_date never predictors; has_items, freight_ratio_missing and payment_missing not in the 24-predictor contract (G-61)
Date-order audit run on every order; violations logged
stages.gate_question: Are joins, grains, targets and leakage exclusions verified?

stages.title: EDA
stages.purpose: Question-driven EDA on orders before the test cutoff: target profiles; outcome trends over time; diagnostics of the 24 contract predictors against each target, importance ranking over all 24 (G-42, G-61) (scatter, Pearson and Spearman; violins and one-hot correlations; class-conditional KDE overlap and per-feature ROC-AUC; mutual information); one importance ranking per task for s04; missingness, outliers and collinearity among raw numeric features; classification only: candidate screen of the s02 screening columns (3.10-3.13, G-68, G-69) with an extended ranking, adoption decided by the team at the gate (G-70).
outputs: candidate_rationale.csv (finding, evidence, change it motivates, stage that tests it)
gate: No order on or after the test cutoff loaded
Outcome trends shown, not volume only
All 24 contract predictors diagnosed against the task's target
Classification: every screening candidate diagnosed; adoption recorded in spec/human_decisions.yaml (adopted_candidates)
Each proposed change linked to an observation
Outputs written under the stage's outputs/, never artifacts/
Stop: eda_review_pack.md presented; team decisions recorded in spec/human_decisions.yaml before s04 runs
stages.gate_question: Does every planned change follow from a pre-cutoff observation?

stages.title: Features
stages.purpose: Define, without fitting: the 24-predictor baseline from e5lib/contract.py (G-61; numeric calendar fields), plus for classification the candidates adopted at the s03 gate (G-70: product_photos_qty, product_description_lenght, seller_prior_review_mean); log1p for the five contract candidates (and, for classification, product_description_lenght; G-70) with pre-cutoff skewness > 1 (G-47, G-62) and for the regression target; the pre-registered label-free reduction to a core set; feature selection by the s03 importance ranking at the team's cumulative threshold (95% or 99%, fixed before any model is fitted); encoded design-matrix rank per recipe; rationale and citations; order_estimated_delivery_date never a feature (G-35); the pipeline recipe per model (impute, encode, scale).
outputs: feature_dictionary.csv (formula, grain, availability, missingness, rationale, citation)
selected_features.json (one set per task, all families)
gate: Reduction and importance selection use pre-cutoff orders only, never test
Every collinearity drop is a recorded team decision with rationale (reduction_rationale.csv)
Threshold and collinearity drops read from spec/human_decisions.yaml (team-decided after s03); s04 stops if missing
No target cap (G-25)
Every retained feature has a rationale
order_estimated_delivery_date not used as a feature or reference (G-35)
Nothing fitted on data
stages.gate_question: Are features and recipes defined without fitting or using labels?

stages.title: Partition
stages.purpose: Sort by purchase time; hold out each task's newest 20% as its test cohort (cutoff computed in s02 by the 80/20 rule; exact IDs frozen); remove test orders whose customer also appears in development; check test size per task (regression >= 15% of eligible delivered orders; classification >= 15% of eligible reviewed orders and of all eligible detractors) and report the prevalence gap, alerting and stopping on failure (no random fallback); build five time-ordered expanding CV folds on development orders with customer purge, label maturity and class-support checks; seed 42 documented.
outputs: counts.json (rows, customers, positives per fold and cohort)
checks.json (customer purge, maturity, rows lost to maturity, class support, minimum training rows)
gate: No test customer in development (repeat customers removed from test; order_id and customer_unique_id checked)
Test size checks per task (G-46)
Never a random split
Five expanding folds; customers purged across training and validation in every fold
Every fold: max training purchase time < min validation purchase time, and no shared customer_unique_id (asserted)
Training outcomes available before each fold origin
Both classes present in every fold (classification)
Any boundary move logged before s06 runs
stages.gate_question: Are folds chronological, customers purged, labels mature and classes supported?

stages.title: Training

purpose.regression: On the s05 folds: median dummy, plain LinearRegression, single decision tree, random forest, each one Pipeline from the s04 recipe; residuals and learning curves; feature set and log transforms fixed by s04 (always on, G-36).
purpose.classification: On the s05 folds: prior dummy, unregularised LogisticRegression, single decision tree, random forest, each one Pipeline from the s04 recipe; learning curves; feature set and log transforms fixed by s04 (always on, G-36).

gate: Identical rows and folds for every candidate
Preprocessing fitted inside folds
Simplest model of each family present
Every model uses the s04 selected features with log transforms on (G-36); no feature or transform testing on the folds
Each more complex family kept only under the s01 decision rule
stages.gate_question: Do the models run basic to complex on identical folds, with each choice justified?

stages.title: Tuning

purpose.regression: Bounded grids on the same folds: Ridge alpha; tree depth and leaf; forest depth and leaf. Every candidate a whole pipeline.
purpose.classification: Bounded grids on the same folds: logistic C; tree depth and leaf; forest depth and leaf; class weight None vs balanced. Every candidate a whole pipeline.

outputs: grid_results.csv (every config: params, fold scores, mean, SD, rank, runtime, convergence)
gate: Grids taken from protocol.yaml
No configuration switched after the search
Pooled out-of-fold and mean-fold scores kept distinct
stages.gate_question: Is every tuned candidate a complete pipeline scored on the same folds?

stages.title: Selection

purpose.regression: Select the model on threshold-free scores against the dummy and simplest models; freeze the recipe; fit on development orders with labels available before the test cutoff; score the test cohort once.
purpose.classification: Select the model on threshold-free scores against the dummy and simplest models; calibration as a candidate component (raw by default, sigmoid variant scored on the same folds if reliability fails); threshold from the chosen probability recipe's out-of-fold predictions under the 5:1 cost; freeze; fit on development orders with labels available before the test cutoff; score the test cohort once.

outputs: threshold_table.csv (classification: no alerts, 0.50, theoretical 1/6, empirical optimum)
bundle/ (pipeline, threshold, schema, versions, training-ID digest, training_profile.json for drift, checksums)
gate: Team decisions for model choice and threshold recorded in spec/human_decisions.yaml (G-39)
Model selected before the threshold
Persisted probability recipe is the one the threshold was chosen on
Final-fit training labels available before the test cutoff
Recipe and threshold frozen before the test cohort is read
Test cohort scored once
Test metrics cover the agreed list (G-24); AP reported once as PR-AUC
stages.gate_question: Was the recipe frozen before the test cohort was scored once?

stages.title: Conclusion
stages.purpose: Train-validation-test table with bootstrap confidence intervals, subgroup errors and drift, interpretation of the selected model, stakeholder actions supported by the evidence, and limitations.
gate: Validation scores labelled as selection scores, not generalisation estimates
Importance explains the selected model
Test cohort described as this experiment's held-out test, scored once in s08 (G-38)
Every recommendation traced to evidence
stages.gate_question: Does every conclusion follow from the test results and their limits?

stages.title: Release
stages.purpose: Reload parity of the bundles; team approval; lead-ordered migration with a reproduction README (README section 12); reproduction check; then the Streamlit app and dashboard, report and slides from the reproduced outputs, walkthrough notebook, and input checks with error handling.
outputs: app/ and dashboard (inside experiments/experiment_5 until migration)
deliverables/ report and deck drafts citing evidence IDs
gate: Every table and chart in the model tabs traced to a stage output in app_sources.json; business dashboard tab labelled as its own descriptive scope (G-41)
App loads the s08 bundle unchanged
Reproduction check matches the release before any deliverable is built
Nothing written outside experiments/experiment_5/ before the lead orders migration
stages.gate_question: Do the app, dashboard, report and slides all trace to one reproduced release?
